related_ask_seg.question: How does the average order amount differ by customer segment?

transformations.name: Group by Segment and Compute Avg Amount

coder_definition.code:
import pandas as pd

def main(df):
    customers_path = '/var/tmp/avaloka/5cdb4de9-b96f-4aa9-aebd-28d49af1cf25/input_78b1c4ea-1451-4adc-85c0-4591167f5c4e.csv'
    orders_path = '/var/tmp/avaloka/142246ec-170c-4e79-86a4-40bfbfc9e00a/input_2bd03d7c-0986-42fa-a2f5-69cdec31b39c.csv'
    df_customers = pd.read_csv(customers_path)
    df_orders = pd.read_csv(orders_path)
    df_orders['amount'] = pd.to_numeric(df_orders['amount'], errors='coerce')
    df_orders['returned'] = df_orders['returned'].astype(bool)
    df_orders = df_orders[~df_orders['returned']]
    df_merged = pd.merge(df_orders, df_customers, on='customer_id', how='inner')
    result = df_merged.groupby('segment', as_index=False).agg(average_order_amount=('amount', 'mean')).sort_values(by='average_order_amount', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
    return result
if __name__ == '__main__':
    placeholder_df = pd.DataFrame()
    output_df = main(placeholder_df)
    output_df.to_csv('output.csv', index=False)
